examples.result: 380 GSR + 337 Gill = 717 gross application dwellings; ZZ Brownfield says 707 net, leaving a 10-unit reconciliation gap.
The 10-unit gap is not auto-corrected because the combined site boundary/net-basis and application boundaries may differ.
LBBD 21/01211/FUL and HNPD 21/01211/FULL are retained as a reference-suffix discrepancy; LBBD remains the authoritative planning-case source.
Gill 22/00416/FULL and 337 dwellings have an independent current GOV.UK HNPD cross-check.
Planning Permission Granted / Awaiting Construction is not converted into completed or occupied status.
ZZ blank geometry is not replaced by joining two application points or nearest-site buffers.
Two Be First history IDs are provenance clues only and are not treated as title identifiers.
Promotion remains zero until exact constituent site/title polygons and current authoritative case bindings reconcile the combined net basis.
